_about: Programs an app must not start: what malware starts. Read by the runner (before a program starts) and by the launcher (for every process that appears in the run's Job Object). A rule matches a command line when one of its words is one of `programs` (folder and .exe left out) and, after that word, a word is one of `flags` (a leading / or dash counts as -) or the rest contains one of `contains`. A rule with neither matches every start of the program. A rule with `"when": "no-network"` applies only to an app that declares no network: the runner refuses the call (like a Python connection), the launcher ends the run when such a program was started behind the runner's back. All lower case.
